name: Exage 500LX four-finger brake lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 340 g for the complete BL-M451-A left/right four-finger brake lever pair with 22.2 mm clamps. The source explicitly states pair; no individual mass is doubled.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1991 dealer product manual, PDF page 71 / printed 68: Exage 500LX named range: unsuffixed FC-M500 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, separately listed BB-M550, BL-M451-A 340 g per pair and BR-M454
